senses.gloss: m. (comessatum, κομεσσᾶτον S.; cmp. אֶפִּיקוֹמָן) (comissatio,) the aftermeal entertainment consisting of an open door reception, at which food and drink are served (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Comissatio).
units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:5">Esth. R. to I, 5</cite> <he>הדא שושן … כבית ק׳ היה וכ׳</he> that (entertainment at) Susa was like the house of a comissatio, food and drink being served there.
